newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady before PPI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits quietly steady before PPI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were quietly steady in dull trade, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said most traders were sidelined before today's issue of the U.S. April producer price index (PPI) and March business inventories data.
The producer price index for April, is forecast to be unchanged from the 0.6 percent increase reported in March.
March business inventories are also expected to unchanged from February's 0.3 percent gain.
"The market was quiet and featureless on lack of fresh factors," a local dealer said.

"There was little impact from Tuesday's retail sales figures and most people were sitting on the sidelines. Some people are waiting for possible direction from today's issue of the producer price index and business inventories figures, but unless the numbers are way off market expectations, I don't think there will be much impact," he said.
In short dates, Wednesday/Thursday and Thursday/Friday were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, respectively.

Among term rates, one-month was unchanged from Tuesday's 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-13/16 5-11/16, nine-months unchanged at 6-1/8 6 and twelve-months unchanged at 6-1/4 6-1/8 percent.
